observations: The preview uses one shared camera, physical floor and original unit-scale robot meshes.

This fixed-camera 2.5D set uses existing high-quality artwork as visual dressing; toys, trolleys, contact shadows and selected foreground features are real 3D. The floor split changes its visible horizon correctly with the phone camera. Backdrop image planes are not complete sculpted room meshes.
Existing room plates are reused without paid generation or destructive edits. Static geometry is batched by material; room actors use fight-detail meshes and no dent geometry.
